name: Mechanic's Diagnostic Triage (Time-Series Signals + Voltage + CAN-Bus + Vision)
description: FIFO parallel pre-flight of vehicle ledger/history, statistical time-series signal & correlation analysis (fuel trims, voltage ripple, O2 waveforms, Z-score glitches), direct CAN-bus bus-health/dropout/byte-heatmap observation, and SAE J2012 DTC reference — followed by a 200-turn ReAct mechanic's root-cause triage.

inputs.name: run_id
inputs.label: Recorded Telemetry Run ID (optional, defaults to latest)

inputs.name: transport
inputs.label: Active OBD-II Transport (sim, tcp, serial, ble)

inputs.name: port_or_addr
inputs.label: Active OBD-II Bridge Address or Serial Port

inputs.name: image_path
inputs.label: Optional Photo (spark plug, belt, PCB, leak)

phases.name: Phase 1: Parallel FIFO Vehicle Ledger, Time-Series Signal Lab, CAN Observer & DTC Reference
phases.description: Concurrently loads vehicle metadata & past service/DTC history, full statistical time-series signal/correlation/voltage analysis, direct CAN-bus jitter/dropout/byte-activity observation, and SAE J2012 DTC definitions.

phases.name: Phase 2: ReAct Multi-Signal, Voltage, CAN-Bus & Multimodal Root-Cause Triage
